protocol.cycle: 600 s continuous stochastic agricultural work cycle
protocol.online_information: public nominal task phase plus present measured demand; no evaluated-seed future samples or offline reference
protocol.shared_start_stop: 25 kW stop, 45 kW restart, 10 s minimum-on, 5 s minimum-off, and 1.5 g/start proxy applied to both controllers
protocol.shared_constraints: 40 kW/s running-engine ramp, 60 kW stable-power floor, 150 kW motor and battery-bus limits, terminal SOC tolerance 0.01
protocol.certification_rule: all hard validity conditions, zero fallback, and zero forecast ramp-envelope infeasibility
protocol.selection_rule: rank fully certified candidates on six development seeds; evaluate the two finalists on 14 disjoint holdout seeds
protocol.scope_limit: Start/stop transitions are not modelled as ordinary running-engine ramp events; this is a shared operating-mode sensitivity, not hardware validation.
